SELECT d."FLOWSTAMP",
       d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_actor' as sender,
       d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' as receiver_country,
       d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'protocol' as protocol,
       CASE WHEN (r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct') IS NOT NULL AND CAST(r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct' AS numeric) != 0
            THEN ROUND(CAST((r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric / (CAST(r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct' AS numeric)) AS numeric), 2)
            ELSE ROUND(CAST((r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric * 100 AS numeric), 2)
       END as res
FROM "DataFlow" d
JOIN "RiskManagement" r ON d."RecordRegistry" = r.flow_link
WHERE (d.flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric > 50000
  AND d.flow_overview->'classification'->>'sensitivity_level' IN ('High', 'Critical')
